ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 5% high-intensity white pixels concentrated at tips and speckles, vs 95% low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white clusters at the distal tips of both left and right lobes. Sparse, non-contiguous white speckling mapped across the lower-medial and mid-right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits roughly 8-10 distinct peaks with higher pixel-amplitude compared to the 6-7 more weathered peaks on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convexity following a smooth curve from the central notch to the pointed terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, thin diagonal linear white scratch approximately 40-50 pixels in length located on the lower-middle region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive encrustations/trauma at both lobe tips; distinct linear rake mark/scratch on the right lobe.
